# rotate/keys.py:6-10  generate
def generate(path: Path, bits: int = 3072) -> str:
    key = paramiko.RSAKey.generate(bits)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    key.write_private_key_file(str(path))
    return f"{key.get_name()} {key.get_base64()}"

# rotate/keys.py (module level)
from pathlib import Path
import paramiko

# rotate/cli.py (module level)
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from rotate.keys import generate
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# rotate/cli.py:7-13  main
def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("host")
    p.add_argument("--dir", default="~/.ssh/rotated")
    args = p.parse_args()
    pub = generate(Path(args.dir).expanduser() / args.host)
    print(pub)
